ggbasket: learn from basketball games, NBA and EuroLeague

Source: R/ggbasket-package.R
ggbasket-package.Rd

Tools to read play-by-play, box-score and shot data from the NBA and the EuroLeague, turn them into the measures analysts use, and draw each answer as a finished, story-first ggplot2 figure.

Details

Conventions: column names are lower case (pts, p3a, orb, tov, ...), opponent stats carry an o_ prefix, shot coordinates are metres from the hoop centre with y pointing towards half court, and play-by-play follows one layout for both leagues (see pbp).

Main entry points:

  • Data: pbp_from_espn(), fetch_euroleague_pbp(), add_lineups(), box_score()

  • One game: plot_game_flow(), scoring_runs(), win_probability(), plot_win_probability(), game_factors(), plot_game_factors(), game_summary()

  • A season of games: on_off(), lineups(), plot_on_off(), game_score(), plot_consistency(), clutch_time(), pressure_effects(), assist_network()

  • Teams: four_factors(), expected_wins(), plot_ratings(), plot_four_factors(), plot_luck()

  • Players: player_rates(), plot_profile(), plot_quadrant(), plot_joint(), plot_spread()

  • Shots: plot_shot_hex(), plot_shot_zones(), shot_curve(), shot_making()

  • Courts and style: geom_court(), theme_ggbasket(), colour_text()
